Column names of the SuSnowDB Tables

default_nn_measurement_types.Rd

See Vignette

Usage

default_nn_measurement_types(
  nn = c("variable_code0", "variable", "unit", "description",
    "measurement_time_interval")
)

default_nn_locations(
  nn = c("location_code", "location_code0", "location_name", "altitude", "city_name",
    "country_code_iso_3166_1", "country_code_iso_3166_2", "country_name", "description",
    "geometry", "location_source", "location_url", "use_limitations")
)

default_nn_measurements(
  nn = c("time", "value", "flag", "location_code0", "variable_code0", "description")
)

Arguments

nn

names of the columns in the "locations" table. See the vignette.

Examples


default_nn_measurement_types()
#> [1] "variable_code0"            "variable"                 
#> [3] "unit"                      "description"              
#> [5] "measurement_time_interval"
default_nn_measurements()
#> [1] "time"           "value"          "flag"           "location_code0"
#> [5] "variable_code0" "description"   
default_nn_locations()
#>  [1] "location_code"           "location_code0"         
#>  [3] "location_name"           "altitude"               
#>  [5] "city_name"               "country_code_iso_3166_1"
#>  [7] "country_code_iso_3166_2" "country_name"           
#>  [9] "description"             "geometry"               
#> [11] "location_source"         "location_url"           
#> [13] "use_limitations"
